author: ArmamentHaki
body:
After asking for Feedback and changing the map a bit I am now releasing it:

World Save: https://www.dropbox.com/s/ysyrh9wod4grp1y/Quarxio%201.0.zip?dl=0
Images: http://imgur.com/a/EUvGw
I didnt manage to make a XML file, but I made a useful txt for a Mapdev,
containing most of the Information needed to create a XML: https://www.dropbox.com/s/642gc9i9vennpli/QuarxioXML.txt?dl=0

-Map Info-

Name : Quarxio, Version 1.0
2 Teams, max 20 Players and min 2 Players
(Purple and Cyan)
3 Objectives, one Obsidian Monument on each side and an emerald one in the middle

The stuff in the chests at spawn may be a bit overpowered, but like everything, it is free to Change.


Of course, I still appreciate feedback and Ratings from non-Mapdevs.

Btw I would like to know if this was accepted, its been more than one month.
